question: Who among the following was the writer of Harshacharita?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Banabhatta__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Banabhatta**

 
 
• **Banabhatta** one of the most accomplished writers in sanskrit prose best known for his chronicle, the** Harshacharita.**
 
• **Banabhatta** was **Sanskrit writer of India who was as harshavardhana's court poet.**
 
• The biography of H**arshvardhana** that he penned is known as the** ''Harshacharita**.**''Banabhatta's **first historial work is** the Harshacharita.**
 
• He served as **the Asthana Kavi** at **the court of King Harsha Vardhana,** who ruled in **north India **from **Sthanvishvara** and later from **Kannauj from 606 and 647 CE.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Indian poet **Bharavi (bhravi)**, who wrote the epic poem **Kirtjunya, **one of the **six mahakavhya**, in traditional sanskrit is famous for it .
 
• **The Amarasimha **was a** sanskrit grammarian and poet** who lived in ancient India. Little is known about his personal life. According to the testimony of** Xuanzang, this is the Chandragupta Vikramaditya who thrived around CE 375.**
 
• **Bhavabhuti **was** an ****Indian scholar **who lived in the eight century and is **remebered for his Sanskrit plays and poetry . **
 
 
• **His plays are compared favourably to Kalidas's creations.**
